hook: Morgan's career is a direct map of where AI governance is coming from in media and entertainment: she built operational legal structures for emerging digital platforms, streaming, apps, immersive venues, before the AI inflection point arrived, then moved into AI legal strategy at Amazon and NBCUniversal. The frameworks she builds now govern how a company the size of NBCU evaluates, procures, and deploys AI across its entire enterprise.
name: Lasherelle Morgan

quote.text: I now use that experience to shape clear, practical approaches that help teams adopt and scale AI responsibly.

moniker: SVP, Legal AI Innovation at NBCUniversal

reading.body:
Lasherelle Morgan currently sets the legal terms under which NBCUniversal evaluates, procures, and deploys AI across its entire enterprise, making her one of the more consequential figures in how a major media company actually operationalizes AI governance.

Her career followed the successive waves of digital transformation in media: M&A foundations at a large firm, then business affairs roles supporting HBO's early streaming work and Viacom's digital platforms, then content legal leadership at Audible and Amazon, then advisory work on MSG Sphere, then an AI legal committee role inside Amazon before moving to her current position. Each stage added a layer of operational legal experience with platforms or infrastructure that were, at the time, new enough to have no settled frameworks. That sequence matters because AI governance at the enterprise level is not primarily a policy exercise, it is a procurement, contracting, and risk-management problem, and Morgan's background is built around exactly those functions.

The data covers her roles and their stated impacts but does not detail the specific frameworks, vendor agreements, or internal policies she has produced at NBCUniversal or Amazon. It does not address how NBCU's AI governance compares to peers, or how decisions made at her level connect to compute procurement or infrastructure choices. What the record does establish is that a single person sitting at the SVP level can function as the choke point through which every AI tool a company of NBCU's scale adopts must pass, and that the person in that role arrived there through two decades of legal work on the platforms AI is now being layered onto.
